This playbook sets out the NHSBSA's expectations for planning and doing analysis.

It provides direction and guidance for everyone at the NHSBSA. It is especially for:

- Directors and Heads of Service, to ensure appropriate governance of analysis in their areas
- Commissioners, users, analysts and analytical assurers, including non-analysts and third-party
  suppliers

It covers all analysis and datasets, whether published externally, used for internal decisions, or
given to sponsors and partners.

## What do you need to do?

Most people arrive with a job rather than a topic. Find yours.

| If this is you | Start here | Then |
|---|---|---|
| **I have been asked to do a piece of analysis** | [Decide your assurance level](guidance/05-deciding-your-assurance-level/index.qmd). Five minutes, at scoping | [Do the work to that level](guidance/06-doing-the-work/index.qmd) |
| **I am commissioning analysis** | [What a commissioner is accountable for](guidance/03-roles-and-responsibilities/index.qmd) | [Phase 1, agreeing the question](guidance/04-analytical-lifecycle/index.qmd), then [the level](guidance/05-deciding-your-assurance-level/index.qmd) |
| **I have been asked to be a critical friend** | [What the role is, and how independent you have to be](guidance/03-roles-and-responsibilities/index.qmd) | [What to review at each level](guidance/06-doing-the-work/index.qmd) |
| **My work scored 4 on an impact dimension** | [Business Critical analysis](guidance/08-business-critical/index.qmd), the whole route in nine steps | |
| **I am publishing this** | [Communicating analysis](guidance/09-communicating-analysis/index.qmd) | [Ethics and transparency](guidance/10-ethics-and-transparency/index.qmd) |
| **I need a template, a log or a form** | [Tools, templates and downloads](guidance/12-tools-and-templates/index.qmd) | |
| **I am stuck, or something here is wrong** | [Getting help](guidance/13-getting-help/index.qmd) | |

## This playbook is based on

- [Government Functional Standard GovS 010: Analysis](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/government-analysis-functional-standard--2/government-functional-standard-govs-010-analysis)
- [The AQuA Book: guidance on producing quality analysis for government](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-aqua-book)
- [The Code of Practice for Statistics](https://osr.statisticsauthority.gov.uk/the-code-of-practice-for-statistics/)

The [Green Book](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/the-green-book-appraisal-and-evaluation-in-central-government)
and [Magenta Book](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/the-magenta-book) also cover analysis
involving appraisal and evaluation.
